propositions.text: The students' demands have been fulfilled.
propositions.notes: affirms = all fulfilled; partial = some fulfilled or being fulfilled; denies = not fulfilled
propositions.query_sr: ispunjeni zahtevi studenata ispunjen zahtev nisu ispunjeni

propositions.text: The students have put forward demands beyond the original four.
propositions.query_sr: novi zahtev studenata peti zahtev dodatni zahtevi
propositions.notes: The original four demands (December 2024): publish the complete reconstruction documentation; drop charges against students and citizens arrested at protests; prosecute those who attacked students and professors; raise the higher-education budget by 20%. Only demands beyond these four count.
